rationale: Plant is positive-gain with 2-4 s pure delay + ~10 s lag, strongly nonlinear: u=0.5 flat at ~0.17 (E1), u=0.65 only moves at low level (E4), u=0.7 decays 0.43->0.37 (E9) so eq~0.37, while u=0.75 rises 0.37->0.48 in 6s (E10), 0.46->0.55 in 5s (E11), 0.56->0.61 in 3.5s (E12) and u=0.8 drives 0.39->0.52 in 5s (E6) and 0.52->0.61 in 4s (E7). Hence static gain dy/du ~5-6 between 0.7-0.8, equilibrium for 0.6 needs ~0.73-0.78, chosen FF=0.75. Observed net rate ~0.023-0.03/s at u=0.8-0.9 and drain ~-0.03/s at y~0.5 (E8: hold 2-3s then 0.62->0.45), tau~10-16s. Noise +-0.02 sd<0.03. Therefore: FF carries steady load for low energy, small P (0.28 => loop gain ~1.4 at high K but capped) + very small I (0.055 with +-0.08 authority, gated to yf>0.45 and |e|<0.3 with conditional freeze on saturation) to avoid windup during 3s delay, D on filtered y (Kd=0.8, tau_d=0.8s) to brake momentum, 1.2s measurement filter to cut noise without adding lag, progressive cap above 0.65 (0.78-2.0*(yf-0.65)) plus hard cap 0.35 above 0.80 and asymmetric slew (up 0.12/s, down 1.5/s) to respect delay momentum and 0.9 hard cutoff with 0.1 margin for unseen true state.
